reason: My doctor said my magnesium might be low and I always forget pills at home. A sachet I can toss in my gym bag with the 2 capsules already counted is the first version of this I would actually take. $24.99 for the first box is easy to try.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every day, and I might forget even with the sachet in my bag. I would also be buying it on TikTok Shop from a brand I have never heard of, so the lab report better really be there.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code did not open a real lab report for the batch, or if the launch price were over about $35, I would skip it.
